thread:
Alex: quick sync — ACME ran into a packaging+network mismatch on their 3rd-party router during private deploy cutover. looking to add a controlled exception path in the compat matrix. any concerns?
Maria: can you summarize the exact failure? short log would help.
Alex: they see control-plane egress blocked for our installer during staged cutover. error: "failed to reach backend: TLS handshake timed out" from the agent.
Sam: is this the case where customer has port 443 blocked egress and only allowed specific SNI hosts?
Alex: yes, they only allow their corporate proxy SNI; our installer tries to reach telemetry.redwood.ai and also pulls images from registry.redwood-infra.com.
Maria: two quick levers: 1) document proxy config and allowlist hosts for installer 2) provide an offline image bundle for fully airgapped installs. both will affect release gating.
Jen: we already have an "airgap bundles" ticket but it was deprioritized. customers pushing for upgrade path that won't require net changes.
Sam: technical note — our current handshake assumes straight TLS egress. Supporting proxy+SNI passthrough requires env var overrides for image registry+controlplane endpoints. small change in installer but more docs + QA.
Alex: propose we add an "installer network exceptions" row in the compatibility matrix: fields = required egress hosts, supported proxy modes, and fallbacks (airgap bundle). we should also include rollout criteria: docs + test automation + field validation script.
Maria: +1. field validation script should be runnable by NetOps: it probes endpoints and returns a short pass/fail and recommended ip/domain list. pseudo:
```
# run from customer jumpbox
curl -v --resolve registry.redwood-infra.com:443:1.2.3.4 https://registry.redwood-infra.com/v2/
# check TLS and SNI
```
Sam: I'll add a small binary that wraps curl checks and outputs JSON for the field team. can target next sprint.
Jen: launch criteria request: we need 1) docs updated, 2) airgap bundle available, 3) validation script in console, 4) two customer pilots + signoff. is that realistic?
Alex: sounds reasonable. timeline ask from sales was "min impact" for Q3 customers. can we compress to one pilot? Maria: one pilot + one internal QA run might be OK if we scope the pilot with tolerant customers.
Sam: risk: if we ship without airgap bundle, some customers will block. building airgap adds ~2 weeks for release automation changes.
Jen: flagging resource conflict — release team has freeze week in 2 sprints. might push to late-Q3 if we want airgap.
Alex: decision needed: allow compat-matrix exception that says "proxy-only customers must run validation script and accept manual networking steps" vs delaying airgap. thoughts?
Maria: we can ship the exception row as interim policy with clear operational steps. include a link-to-template for NetOps comms and escalation path.
Sam: code-wise we can add env overrides in installer quickly; I'll open a PR and request a small e2e in the CI.
Jen: ok, I'll update the roadmap card: add compat exception row, label status=beta, add acceptance criteria (docs + validation + PR merged).
Alex: assign owners: Sam = installer change + CI test, Maria = validation script + field template, Jen = roadmap + pilot org. I'll coordinate with sales on which customer to pilot.
deploy-bot: deployment pipeline triggered for branch feature/installer-proxy-overrides (build 3827). :rocket:
Maria: thanks — one more ask: include an additional matrix column for "NetOps effort" (low/medium/high). customers care about the ops steps.
Alex: good call. include that and a short checklist in the matrix row. I'll update the doc now and ping you all. :thumbsup:
